subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should Control UI gain a first-class project/session hierarchy, and which durable semantics should selected-message triage and multi-session composer routing use: branch-copy, destructive move, or neither?
rationale: The request crosses persisted session state, transcript semantics, Gateway protocol, and UI navigation; code review cannot safely choose the permanent user model or compatibility boundary.

options.title: Stage a project-and-branch design
options.body: Keep this issue as the UI product tracker and first specify additive project/session metadata plus non-destructive branch-copy semantics before considering composer fanout.

options.title: Limit scope to navigation
options.body: Approve only project-like grouping and session switching, leaving transcript triage and multi-target sending out of the first iteration.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep existing session pin/archive/rename workflows as the supported model until a broader projects product direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Stage a project-and-branch design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the UI product tracker and first specify additive project/session metadata plus non-destructive branch-copy semantics before considering composer fanout.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged history owns current session-management behavior and this issue already has prior routing review on the same boundary.
